# LIV (Nightclub): A Comprehensive Analysis of Operations, Design, Brand Equity, and Cultural Impact
## I. Title
LIV is a globally recognized nightlife brand and high-revenue entertainment venue, originally established in Miami Beach, Florida, and subsequently expanded to Las Vegas, Nevada. Since its inception in 2008, the venue has functioned not merely as a discotheque but as a pivotal institution in the modern "megaclub" economy, fundamentally changing the landscape of hospitality, celebrity culture, and electronic music performance Founded by David Grutman and the Miami Marketing Group (MMG)—which later evolved into Groot Hospitality—LIV is physically located within the historic Fontainebleau hotel properties in both cities, a strategic alignment that leverages mid-century architectural heritage with contemporary technological innovation .

The nomenclature of the brand, "LIV," serves as a dual-layered historical and cultural signifier. It represents the Roman numeral for 54, referencing 1954, the year the original Fontainebleau Miami Beach opened its doors. Simultaneously, it pays homage to Studio 54, the legendary Manhattan nightclub that defined the disco era's intersection of celebrity, exclusivity, and hedonism This branding strategy clearly positions LIV as the spiritual successor to the Studio 54 ethos, adapted for the 21st-century experiential economy.

Operating in the highest echelon of the global nightlife market, LIV consistently ranks among the top-grossing venues in the United States, frequently appearing in the top five of *Nightclub & Bar* magazine's Top 100 list alongside massive Las Vegas casino clubs Its economic success is underpinned by a business model that prioritizes high-check average table service, aggressive talent acquisition, and continuous capital reinvestment in kinetic architecture and immersive technology Beyond its financial metrics, LIV has achieved a rare level of cultural ubiquity, particularly within the hip-hop community, where the "LIV on Sunday" event has become a recurring lyrical motif and a status symbol for industry success .

This report provides an exhaustive examination of LIV's history, architectural development, economic performance, legal challenges, and cultural significance. By analyzing data regarding its revenue generation, design specifications, and litigious history, this document aims to elucidate how LIV has sustained its relevance in a volatile industry and successfully navigated a major expansion into the saturated Las Vegas market.

## II. Historical Genesis and The Miami Foundation (2008–2023)
### The Fontainebleau Revitalization Project
The genesis of LIV is inextricably linked to the broader revitalization of the Fontainebleau Miami Beach, one of the most significant architectural landmarks in Florida. Originally designed by Morris Lapidus and opened in 1954, the hotel had lost much of its luster by the turn of the millennium. In the mid-2000s, the property underwent a massive $1 billion renovation aimed at restoring its status as the crown jewel of Millionaire's Row .

LIV was conceived as the nightlife anchor of this renovation. The venue opened in November 2008, a timing that coincided with the onset of the global financial crisis. Despite the economic downturn, the club's launch was executed with a high-profile strategy, hosting the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show after-party as its grand opening event . This decision established an immediate precedent for exclusivity and high-production value that would insulate the venue from the recessionary pressures affecting mid-tier nightlife establishments.

### The Rise of the "Megaclub" Model
Upon its opening, LIV introduced Miami to the "megaclub" format—a model previously perfected in Las Vegas but less common in the more lounge-centric South Beach market. The venue utilized the hotel's original theater space, resulting in a soaring 30-foot dome ceiling and an amphitheater-style layout . This architectural choice facilitated a "stadium" energy where VIP tables were tiered around the dance floor, ensuring that high-spending patrons were both spectators of the crowd and part of the spectacle itself .

By 2011, barely three years into its operation, LIV had disrupted the national nightlife hierarchy. According to *Nightclub & Bar* magazine, LIV generated between $35 million and $45 million in annual revenue, breaking into the top five highest-grossing clubs in the nation . It was notably the only venue in the top tier located outside of Las Vegas, competing directly with heavyweights like Marquee, XS, and TAO .

### Management and Corporate Evolution
The operational success of LIV catapulted its co-founder, David Grutman, to international prominence. Grutman's management firm, the Miami Marketing Group (MMG), executed a strategy that blended relentless celebrity outreach with operational rigor . In October 2019, the trajectory of the brand shifted when Live Nation Entertainment, the world's largest concert promoter, acquired a majority stake in Groot Hospitality .

This acquisition integrated LIV into a global entertainment portfolio, providing the venue with unprecedented access to talent booking infrastructure and capital. The partnership with Live Nation validated the nightclub business as a scalable corporate asset rather than a volatile independent venture, setting the stage for the brand's eventual expansion westward .

### Continuous Reinvention: The 2016 Renovation
A core tenet of LIV's management philosophy is the rejection of complacency. In an industry prone to rapid trend cycles, LIV has extended its lifecycle through significant capital expenditures. The most notable of these was the summer 2016 renovation, a $10 million project that closed the venue for two months .

The renovation was not merely cosmetic but structural and technological. It introduced "The Spider," a kinetic lighting installation that became the venue's visual signature (see Section IV). This investment, which owner David Grutman noted was necessary to "never stay complacent," ensured that the club remained competitive against newer market entrants like E11EVEN and Story .

## III. Architectural Design and Kinetic Technology
The architectural identity of LIV is defined by its transition from static luxury to kinetic immersion. The design philosophy posits that the physical environment must be responsive to the music and the energy of the crowd.

### LIV Miami: The Theater of Technology
The Miami venue occupies approximately 18,000 to 22,000 square feet (estimates vary based on renovation configurations) within the Fontainebleau's historic footprint. The defining feature of the space is the interaction between the historic domed ceiling and modern LED technology.

#### The "Spider" Installation
The centerpiece of the 2016 renovation was the "Spider," designed by Stephen Lieberman of SJ Lighting . This installation represented a paradigm shift in club lighting design.

* **Composition:** The structure consists of a central steel truss with seven distinct "legs." 
* **Technology:** It houses over 400 digitally controlled LED screens . 
* **Kinetic Movement:** Unlike static chandeliers, the Spider is fully automated. The legs and screens can move rhythmically, descending toward the crowd or retracting into the dome, effectively changing the volume and intimacy of the room in real-time . 
* **Synchronization:** The installation is networked with LED-clad columns throughout the venue, creating a 360-degree visual environment where video content flows seamlessly from the ceiling to the floor . 
* **Cost:** The installation of the Spider alone accounted for approximately 30% of the entire $10 million renovation budget, underscoring the high capital barriers to entry in the top-tier nightlife market .

### LIV Las Vegas: The "Gladiatorial" Design
The expansion to Las Vegas required a design that could stand out in the most competitive nightlife market in the world. The Las Vegas venue, located in the Fontainebleau Las Vegas, was designed by the Rockwell Group in collaboration with SJ Lighting for production systems and Sound Investment AV for audio .

#### Spatial Configuration (2023–2024)
Upon opening in December 2023, LIV Las Vegas spanned roughly 50,000 square feet . The design was characterized as "gladiatorial," emphasizing a focused, arena-like energy.

* **Sightlines:** The venue featured a "stadium" layout where VIP banquettes were tiered. This ensured that regardless of location—whether on the dance floor or the mezzanine—guests had unobstructed views of the DJ booth . 
* **The "Halo":** The ceiling design featured an hourglass-shaped structure with soft, curved radial lines, differing from the Miami "Spider" but maintaining the commitment to overhead spectacle . 
* **Lighting Rig:** The lighting system utilized Ayrton fixtures, including hybrid and wash lights controlled by grandMA3 consoles, to create complex aerial effects .

#### The 2024–2025 Expansion and Merger
Less than a year after opening, LIV Las Vegas underwent an "eight-figure" renovation for the 2024–2025 season . This project physically merged the indoor nightclub with the outdoor LIV Beach dayclub.

* **Total Area:** The combination expanded the venue's total footprint to approximately 80,000 square feet . 
* **Stage Modification:** The DJ stage was lowered to foster a greater connection between the artist and the crowd, moving away from the "god-like" separation typical of early 2010s EDM festivals . 
* **Flow:** The renovation removed physical barriers, allowing the 35,000-square-foot pool deck to serve as an extension of the nightclub. This created a fluid indoor-outdoor environment where capacity could scale dynamically based on attendance .

### LIV Beach Design
LIV Beach acts as the daytime counterpart to the nightclub.

* **Scale:** 35,000 square feet located on the resort's fourth-floor rooftop . 
* **Luxury Amenities:** The venue includes six private bungalows, each equipped with its own private plunge pool, catering to the ultra-high-net-worth demographic . 
* **Expansion:** The 2024–2025 renovation added 33 new tables to the beach club area, significantly increasing the inventory for bottle service sales .

## IV. Economic Performance and Market Position
LIV's business model is a case study in the economics of scarcity and prestige. By strictly controlling entry and enforcing high minimum spends for tables, the venue maximizes revenue per square foot.

### Revenue Rankings and Analysis
Since 2011, LIV has consistently appeared in the upper echelons of revenue rankings for American nightlife.

**Table 1: Comparative Revenue Estimates (Historical Context)**

| Year | Venue | Location | Estimated Revenue | Rank | Source |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 2011 | Marquee | Las Vegas | $70 \- $80 Million | \#1 | 4 |
| 2011 | XS Nightclub | Las Vegas | $60 \- $70 Million | \#2 | 4 |
| 2011 | LIV | Miami Beach | $35 \- $45 Million | \#5 | 4 |
| 2015 | LIV | Miami Beach | $40 \- $45 Million | \#5 | 1 |
| 2014 | E11EVEN | Miami | \~$20 Million | Top 10 | 17 |

**Analysis:**

* **Market Dominance:** In the early 2010s, LIV was the only non-Vegas venue capable of generating revenue comparable to the massive casino clubs. While Marquee and XS generated nearly double the revenue, they also benefited from the massive foot traffic of the Las Vegas Strip . For a standalone market like Miami Beach, LIV's performance was statistically anomalous. 
* **Resilience:** Even as new competitors entered the Miami market—most notably E11EVEN in 2014—LIV maintained its top-ranking position through 2015 and beyond . E11EVEN's 24-hour license presented a different business model, but LIV retained the crown for peak-hour luxury nightlife revenue.

### The Pricing Structure
LIV's revenue is driven primarily by "table service" (bottle service), with general admission acting as a secondary stream that provides the necessary critical mass of energy.

* **Cover Charges:** Entry fees are dynamic. Standard nights may see cover charges between $60 and $80, but these prices are highly elastic. During peak events (New Year's Eve, Art Basel), ticket prices can exceed $100 or significantly more for expedited entry . 
* **Table Minimums:** The Las Vegas expansion pushed pricing to new heights. Stage-side tables at LIV Las Vegas were marketed with minimum spends of up to $25,000 per night upon opening . This pricing strategy relies on the "Veblen good" effect, where higher prices increase the desirability and perceived status of the inventory.

### The Live Nation Impact
The 2019 acquisition of a majority stake in Groot Hospitality by Live Nation 10 suggests a shift in the economic structure of the brand. By integrating with a global promoter, LIV can potentially reduce talent acquisition costs or secure "package deals" for artists touring Live Nation venues, improving profit margins despite the skyrocketing fees demanded by top-tier DJs.

## V. Programming, Talent, and "LIV on Sunday"
The core product of LIV is not alcohol, but access to celebrity culture. The venue's programming strategy is bifurcated between Electronic Dance Music (EDM) and Hip Hop, allowing it to capture two distinct but overlapping demographics.

### "LIV on Sunday": A Cultural Institution
While Fridays and Saturdays are often dedicated to house and EDM, Sunday nights at LIV are reserved for hip hop. Known simply as "LIV on Sunday," this weekly event has achieved mythic status in the music industry. It is frequently cited as the most important weekly hip-hop party in the world .

* **The "Church" of Nightlife:** The event is characterized by its high energy and the attendance of rap royalty. It is less about a specific performance and more about the congregation of talent. 
* **Lyrical Immortalization:** The cultural penetration of this event is evidenced by its frequent references in popular music. 
 * **Meek Mill:** In the song "Amen" (feat. Drake), the chorus explicitly compares the party to a religious service: *"Do Liv on Sunday like a church (Preach)"*.6 This lyric underscores the ritualistic nature of the event for the hip-hop community. 
 * **Ace Hood:** The track "Hustle Hard" delineates the Miami party itinerary: *"LIV on Sunday, King of Diamonds Monday"*.1 This line documents the specific weekly migration pattern of Miami's nightlife elite.

### Resident DJs and Global Residencies
LIV competes for talent on a global scale, securing residencies that rival those of Ibiza and Las Vegas.

* **David Guetta (2025):** In a major strategic move for the new Las Vegas venue, David Guetta signed a two-year exclusive residency starting in 2025\. This deal covers both LIV Miami and LIV Las Vegas/Beach, tying the artist's brand to the venue's expansion . 
* **Tiësto:** A staple of the Las Vegas strip, Tiësto was a headline resident for the opening of the Fontainebleau Las Vegas, bridging the gap between the established Vegas market and the new venue . 
* **John Summit:** Representing the new wave of tech-house popularity, John Summit was secured for high-profile dates, including New Year's Eve 2025 . 
* **Local Legends:** In Miami, the venue maintains stability through long-term resident DJs such as DJ Khaled, who often serves as a host, and local favorites like DJ Stevie J .

## VI. Legal Disputes and Intellectual Property
As a high-profile brand, LIV has been involved in significant legal battles, ranging from trademark disputes to liability claims.

### The LIV Nightclub vs. LIV Golf Trademark Dispute
The most significant commercial litigation involving the brand is the trademark dispute with **LIV Golf**, the professional golf tour financed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. This conflict arose when LIV Golf attempted to register federal trademarks for its league.

* **The Conflict:** In March 2023, LIV Nightclub (Groot Hospitality) filed a Notice of Opposition with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) to block LIV Golf's registration . 
* **The Argument:** The nightclub's legal team argued that the marks were "visually, phonetically, and aurally similar" and that the coexistence of the brands would cause "consumer confusion" and "dilute the distinctive quality" of the nightclub's mark, which had been in use for 15 years prior . 
* **The "54" Connection:** The dispute is complicated by the shared etymology of the name. 
 * **LIV Golf:** Uses "LIV" as the Roman numeral for 54, representing the score of a perfect round (birdieing every hole on a par-72) and the number of holes played in their tournaments . 
 * **LIV Nightclub:** Uses "LIV" as the Roman numeral for 54, representing 1954, the founding year of the Fontainebleau . 
* **Status:** As of late 2025, the opposition proceedings appeared to be suspended or ongoing, with the USPTO records indicating a "Suspended" status on the opposition pending outcome of other proceedings or settlement talks . This dispute highlights the immense value placed on the "LIV" brand name and the nightclub's aggressive defense of its intellectual property against even sovereign-wealth-backed entities.

### Liability and Security Incidents
The high-intensity environment of LIV has occasionally resulted in litigation regarding security and patron safety.

* **Tory Lanez Lawsuit (2019):** In November 2019, rapper Tory Lanez was sued by Christopher Harty, a patron who alleged he was assaulted by Lanez and his security detail inside the club. The lawsuit claimed that a verbal altercation escalated into a physical beating, resulting in blunt force trauma. This case underscored the liability risks associated with hosting volatile celebrity entourages . 
* **Diddy vs. Drake (2014):** A physical altercation between Sean "Diddy" Combs and Drake occurred outside LIV in December 2014\. While this did not result in a lawsuit against the club itself, it became a defining moment in hip-hop folklore, allegedly stemming from a dispute over the rights to the beat for the song "0 to 100" .

### Crypto-Asset Promotion (EthereumMax)
LIV was tangentially implicated in the class-action lawsuit concerning the "pump and dump" allegations of the cryptocurrency EthereumMax (EMAX). Following the Bitcoin 2021 conference in Miami, LIV hosted an official after-party where EMAX was promoted and accepted for payment. While the primary legal targets were celebrity endorsers like Kim Kardashian and Floyd Mayweather, the venue served as the physical stage for the alleged promotional misconduct .

## VII. Expansion: The Las Vegas Case Study
The opening of LIV Las Vegas in December 2023 marked the brand's most ambitious expansion. This move was not merely a franchise replication but a strategic attempt to capture market share in the global capital of nightlife.

### The Long Road to Opening
The Fontainebleau Las Vegas project had a troubled history, sitting unfinished for over a decade due to the 2008 financial crisis and subsequent ownership changes. When the project was finally revived, the inclusion of LIV as the primary nightlife partner was a signal of the developers' intent to import the "Miami vibe" to the Strip .

### Design Adaptation and Scale
The Las Vegas venue required an adaptation of the Miami model to fit the scale of Vegas.

* **Size:** The original 50,000 square foot footprint (later expanded to 80,000) dwarfs the Miami location . 
* **Integration:** Unlike the Miami location, which was retrofitted into a 1954 building, the Vegas venue was purpose-built. This allowed for better integration of technical systems, such as the seamless flow between the indoor club and the outdoor pool deck . 
* **Competition:** LIV Las Vegas entered a market dominated by established players like Wynn Nightlife (XS, Encore Beach Club) and Tao Group (Omnia, Hakkasan). To compete, LIV leveraged its "Miami cool" factor—a distinct brand identity compared to the corporate polish of Vegas clubs—and the immediate integration of high-value amenities like the private bungalows with plunge pools .

### The 2024-2025 Renovation Strategy
The decision to renovate and expand the Vegas venue less than a year after opening 1 indicates an aggressive adaptive strategy. By lowering the stage and merging the venues, management likely responded to early operational feedback regarding crowd flow and energy. The expansion to 80,000 square feet effectively created a "super-venue" capable of hosting festival-sized crowds, positioning it to dominate major weekends like F1 Las Vegas and the Super Bowl.

## VIII. Conclusion
LIV stands as a paradigm of the modern nightlife industry. From its origins in the revitalization of the Fontainebleau Miami Beach to its aggressive expansion into Las Vegas, the brand has successfully monetized the convergence of celebrity culture, electronic music, and luxury hospitality. Its architectural innovations, particularly the kinetic "Spider" and the indoor-outdoor integration in Las Vegas, have set technical standards for the industry.

However, the brand's prominence has also made it a lightning rod for legal and cultural conflicts, from high-stakes trademark battles with LIV Golf to liability issues involving A-list performers. Despite these challenges, LIV's consistent revenue performance and its indelible mark on pop culture—immortalized in the lyrics of the era's biggest hip-hop artists—confirm its status as one of the most influential nightlife brands of the 21st century. As it settles into its dual-city operation, the brand's ability to maintain its "cool" factor while operating at a corporate scale will be the defining challenge of its next decade.

## IX. Detailed Data Tables
### Table 2: Comparative Specifications of LIV Locations
| Feature | LIV Miami | LIV Las Vegas (Post-2024 Renovation) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Location** | Fontainebleau Miami Beach | Fontainebleau Las Vegas |
| **Opening Date** | November 2008 7 | December 2023 3 |
| **Square Footage** | \~18,000 \- 22,000 sq ft 33 | \~80,000 sq ft (Combined with Beach) 1 |
| **Capacity** | \~1,000 \- 1,200 33 | \~2,000+ (plus overflow) 12 |
| **Key Architectural Feature** | The Dome & Kinetic "Spider" 1 | Hourglass "Halo" & Indoor/Outdoor Merger 13 |
| **Dayclub Component** | Not directly integrated | LIV Beach (Merged flow) 14 |
| **Lighting Design** | SJ Lighting (Stephen Lieberman) 1 | Rockwell Group / SJ Lighting 11 |

### Table 3: Notable Resident Artists and Events (2024-2025)
| Artist / Event | Role | Significance | Origin |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **David Guetta** | Resident DJ | 2-Year Exclusive Residency (2025) | 20 |
| **John Summit** | Performer | NYE 2025 Headliner (Las Vegas) | 22 |
| **Tiësto** | Resident DJ | Grand Opening Headliner (Las Vegas) | 21 |
| **Meduza** | Performer | NYE 2025 Headliner (Miami) | 34 |
| **LIV on Sunday** | Weekly Event | Hip-Hop Cultural Staple | 1 |
| **DJ Khaled** | Resident/Host | Miami | 35 |

Note on Sources: 
This report synthesizes information from various industry reports, legal filings, and news outlets. Specific data points are referenced using the bracketed identifiers (eg3) corresponding to the research snippets provided.

This line documents the specific weekly migration pattern of Miami's nightlife elite.
LIV competes for talent on a global scale, securing residencies that rival those of Ibiza and Las Vegas.
David Guetta signed a two-year exclusive residency starting in 2025 for the new Las Vegas venue.
This deal covers both LIV Miami and LIV Las Vegas/Beach, tying David Guetta's brand to the venue's expansion.
Tiësto, a staple of the Las Vegas strip, was a headline resident for the opening of the Fontainebleau Las Vegas.
Tiësto bridged the gap between the established Vegas market and the new venue.
John Summit, representing the new wave of tech-house popularity, was secured for high-profile dates, including New Year's Eve 2025.
In Miami, LIV maintains stability through long-term resident DJs such as DJ Khaled, who often serves as a host, and local favorites like DJ Stevie J.
The most significant commercial litigation involving the LIV brand is the trademark dispute with LIV Golf, the professional golf tour financed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund.
This conflict arose when LIV Golf attempted to register federal trademarks for its league.
In March 2023, LIV Nightclub (Groot Hospitality) filed a Notice of Opposition with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) to block LIV Golf's registration.
The nightclub's legal team argued that the marks were "visually, phonetically, and aurally similar."

The nightclub's legal team argued that the coexistence of the brands would cause "consumer confusion" and "dilute the distinctive quality" of the nightclub's mark, which had been in use for 15 years prior.
The dispute between LIV Nightclub and LIV Golf is complicated by the shared etymology of the name.
LIV Golf uses "LIV" as the Roman numeral for 54, representing the score of a perfect round (birdieing every hole on a par-72) and the number of holes played in their tournaments.
LIV Nightclub uses "LIV" as the Roman numeral for 54, representing 1954, the founding year of the Fontainebleau.
As of late 2025, the opposition proceedings between LIV Nightclub and LIV Golf appeared to be suspended or ongoing.
USPTO records indicate a "Suspended" status on the opposition pending outcome of other proceedings or settlement talks.
This dispute highlights the immense value placed on the "LIV" brand name and the nightclub's aggressive defense of its intellectual property against even sovereign-wealth-backed entities.
The high-intensity environment of LIV has occasionally resulted in litigation regarding security and patron safety.
In November 2019, rapper Tory Lanez was sued by Christopher Harty, a patron who alleged he was assaulted by Lanez and his security detail inside LIV club.
The lawsuit claimed that a verbal altercation escalated into a physical beating, resulting in blunt force trauma.
This case underscored the liability risks associated with hosting volatile celebrity entourages.
A physical altercation between Sean "Diddy" Combs and Drake occurred outside LIV in December 2014.
While this did not result in a lawsuit against LIV club itself, it became a defining moment in hip-hop folklore, allegedly stemming from a dispute over the rights to the beat for the song "0 to 100".
LIV was tangentially implicated in the class-action lawsuit concerning the "pump and dump" allegations of the cryptocurrency EthereumMax (EMAX).
Following the Bitcoin 2021 conference in Miami, LIV hosted an official after-party where EMAX was promoted and accepted for payment.
While the primary legal targets were celebrity endorsers like Kim Kardashian and Floyd Mayweather, LIV venue served as the physical stage for the alleged promotional misconduct.
The opening of LIV Las Vegas in December 2023 marked the brand's most ambitious expansion.
This move was not merely a franchise replication but a strategic attempt to capture market share in the global capital of nightlife.
The Fontainebleau Las Vegas project had a troubled history, sitting unfinished for over a decade due to the 2008 financial crisis and subsequent ownership changes.
When the Fontainebleau Las Vegas project was finally revived, the inclusion of LIV as the primary nightlife partner was a signal of the developers' intent to import the "Miami vibe" to the Strip.
The Las Vegas venue required an adaptation of the Miami model to fit the scale of Vegas.
The original 50,000 square foot footprint of LIV Las Vegas (later expanded to 80,000) dwarfs the Miami location.
Unlike the Miami location, which was retrofitted into a 1954 building, the Vegas venue was purpose-built.
This allowed for better integration of technical systems, such as the seamless flow between the indoor club and the outdoor pool deck.
LIV Las Vegas entered a market dominated by established players like Wynn Nightlife (XS, Encore Beach Club) and Tao Group (Omnia, Hakkasan).

To compete, LIV leveraged its "Miami cool" factor—a distinct brand identity compared to the corporate polish of Vegas clubs—and the immediate integration of high-value amenities like the private bungalows with plunge pools.
The decision to renovate and expand the Vegas venue less than a year after opening indicates an aggressive adaptive strategy.
By lowering the stage and merging the venues, management likely responded to early operational feedback regarding crowd flow and energy.
The expansion to 80,000 square feet effectively created a "super-venue" capable of hosting festival-sized crowds, positioning it to dominate major weekends like F1 Las Vegas and the Super Bowl.
LIV stands as a paradigm of the modern nightlife industry.

From its origins in the revitalization of the Fontainebleau Miami Beach to its aggressive expansion into Las Vegas, the LIV brand has successfully monetized the convergence of celebrity culture, electronic music, and luxury hospitality.
LIV's architectural innovations, particularly the kinetic "Spider" and the indoor-outdoor integration in Las Vegas, have set technical standards for the industry.
The LIV brand's prominence has also made it a lightning rod for legal and cultural conflicts, from high-stakes trademark battles with LIV Golf to liability issues involving A-list performers.

Despite these challenges, LIV's consistent revenue performance and its indelible mark on pop culture—immortalized in the lyrics of the era's biggest hip-hop artists—confirm its status as one of the most influential nightlife brands of the 21st century.
As it settles into its dual-city operation, the LIV brand's ability to maintain its "cool" factor while operating at a corporate scale will be the defining challenge of its next decade.
LIV Miami's opening date was November 2008.
LIV Las Vegas's opening date was December 2023.
LIV Miami has a square footage of ~18,000 - 22,000 sq ft.
LIV Las Vegas (Post-2024 Renovation) has a total square footage of ~80,000 sq ft (Combined with Beach).
LIV Miami has a capacity of ~1,000 - 1,200.
LIV Las Vegas (Post-2024 Renovation) has a capacity of ~2,000+ (plus overflow).
A key architectural feature of LIV Miami is The Dome & Kinetic "Spider."
A key architectural feature of LIV Las Vegas (Post-2024 Renovation) is the Hourglass "Halo" & Indoor/Outdoor Merger.
LIV Miami does not have a directly integrated dayclub component.
LIV Las Vegas (Post-2024 Renovation) has LIV Beach as a dayclub component with merged flow.
The lighting design for LIV Miami was done by SJ Lighting (Stephen Lieberman).
The lighting design for LIV Las Vegas (Post-2024 Renovation) was done by Rockwell Group / SJ Lighting.
David Guetta is a Resident DJ with a 2-Year Exclusive Residency (2025).
John Summit is a Performer and the NYE 2025 Headliner (Las Vegas).
Tiësto is a Resident DJ and the Grand Opening Headliner (Las Vegas).
Meduza is a Performer and the NYE 2025 Headliner (Miami).
LIV on Sunday is a Weekly Event and a Hip-Hop Cultural Staple.
DJ Khaled is a Resident/Host in Miami.

3.title: LIV Nightclub Las Vegas
3.description: The official guide to LIV Las Vegas. View upcoming events, free guest list & bottle service by contacting LIV Nightclub directly.
3.content:
Located at the iconic Fontainebleau Las Vegas, LIV Las Vegas promises a night like no other. Born in Miami, the 50,000 square-foot, world-renowned LIV delivers high-energy, A-list entertainment along with signature VIP service. The club will offer 62 VIP tables, built around it’s DJ booth, making all 2,000 guests feel like they’re in the middle of all the action while giving everyone a view of the DJ. LIV’s DJ lineup for 2025 will consist of [John Summit](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/john-summit-liv-nightclub/), [Dom Dolla](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/dom-dolla-liv-nightclub/), [James Kennedy](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/james-kennedy-las-vegas/), [Metro Boomin](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/metro-boomin-las-vegas/), [Tiesto](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/tiesto-las-vegas/) and [Calvin Harris](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/calvin-harris-las-vegas/).

Before we get into the insider tips, take a minute to watch this video and see what to expect when visiting LIV Nightclub Las Vegas. When you’re ready to book or have questions, visit our VIP host directory to get in touch with a [lead VIP host at LIV](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/hosts/liv-nightclub-vip-host/) directly!

About LIV Las Vegas
-------------------

### Where is LIV Nightclub located?

LIV Nightclub is located at Fontainebleau Las Vegas, which can be found at 2777 S Las Vegas Blvd.

When is LIV Las Vegas open?
---------------------------

LIV Nightclub is open Friday through Sunday nights from 10:00pm to 4am.

Average wait times are expected to be around 1 hour. Plan to arrive by 10:00pm. Check out the [LIV Las Vegas event calendar](https://calendar.lasvegasnightclubs.com/liv-nightclub-events)for all upcoming events.

### How much does it cost to get in?

General admission for LIV Nightclub will start around $30 for girls and $50 for guys. Holiday weekends and special guest performers will have higher pricing. All guests must be 21 years of age or older with valid, government issued ID.

### Do I need tickets to get into LIV Nightclub?

[Tickets](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/tickets/liv-nightclub-tickets/) will always guarantee your entry into the club, especially on holiday weekends and special performances.

### Does LIV Nightclub have a guest list?

Yes! LIV will offer [guest list](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/liv-nightclub-guest-list/) for men and women. It will be available Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

### How much is bottle service at LIV Nightclub?

LIV table minimums are expected to start at $2000, but can varies depending on demand and what event LIV has going on. For an accurate quote on a LIV bottle service, Contact a LIV Las Vegas VIP host or read our [LIV bottle service guide](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/liv-nightclub-bottle-service/).

### What is the best table location?

The stage tables are expected to be the hottest tables at LIV Nightclub in Las Vegas. As we receive more details on seating and pricing, we will update this page.

### What are drink prices?

We plan on mixed drinks and cocktails to start at $20, beers $14 and shots $15.

### What kind of music does LIV Las Vegas play?

Expect to hear everything from EDM and Deep House to Hip-Hop. music.

What is the LIV Nightclub dress code?
-------------------------------------

So that there isn’t any problem getting into LIV, once at the rope, gentlemen should make sure to wear a [collared shirt](https://lasvegasnightclubs.com/guides/what-are-las-vegas-dress-codes/). Always be mindful of wearing nicer shoes and avoid anything that can be considered sportswear (track jackets, jerseys, sports shoes, hats, etc). Remember, Upscale fashion-forward attire. No fitted caps, shorts, or printed shirts with offensive or aggressive graphics. LIV Nightclub dress code is very strict, so be sure to follow the rules and **make sure you don’t come in swim attire!**

---------------------

We make getting in touch with LIV Nightclub at Fontainebleau easy. Just fill out the form below and a VIP host who works with LIV will get back to you as soon as possible. Once you have submitted the form, you will be given the hosts contact information incase you need to make a same day reservation or immediate response.

Top 20 Most Successful Night Clubs of 2011, Vegas Dominates List
================================================================

![Image 21: Crowd of people in a club with their hands up, and it is called Marquee Nightclub & Dayclub on the bottom](https://www.foodbeast.com/wp-content/uploads/2012/02/marquee.jpg)

[![Image 22: marquee](https://cdn.foodbeast.com.s3.amazonaws.com/content/wp-content/uploads/2012/02/marquee.jpg)](https://cdn.foodbeast.com.s3.amazonaws.com/content/wp-content/uploads/2012/02/marquee.jpg)

For all you avid club goers and hopeful Roxburians, _Nightclub & Bar_ magazine has just [published a list](https://www.nightclub.com/awards/top-100/nightclub-bar-2012-top-100-reflects-success) of the most successful nightclubs from across the United States. 12 of the top 20 clubs on the list reside in Sin City, with the top most grossing club being _Marquee Nightclub & Dayclub_, a multi-level venue that’s been open less than a year and boasts revenue in excess of **$70 million**.

Apart from Marquee’s proper alignment with quality EDM acts and solid recurring performances from notable artists, the club’s dual night and day club presence definitely allows for more revenue opportunity at a time when other establishments on the list are closed for business.

The list, developed by _Nightclub & Bar_ and aided by hospitality research firm _Technomic_, shows that the Top 100 high-volume bars and clubs around the nation generated $1.4 billion, a 9.2% increase from the numbers published a year prior. Looks like even in a “down economy” people still find their way to the club, find their way to the bar, and find their way to pricey table service.

The next few clubs on the list are also serious Las Vegas mainstayers, ala _XS_ and _TAO_, two clubs with extremely different vibes but similar revenue numbers. _TAO_ boasts similarly popular day club features in the form of _TAO Beach_.

LIV nightclub out in Miami Beach breaks the top 5 list with an estimated $35-55 million in revenue. Apart from Nevada and Florida, the only other states represented in the top 20 are California, Maryland,New York and New Jersey.

For those of you who’ve been to these clubs, or your favorite mega nightclub didn’t make the list, how do you feel about the rankings? Surprising?

1.   **Marquee Nightclub & Dayclub**, Las Vegas, NV — _$70-80 MM_
2.   **XS Nightclub**, Las Vegas, NV — _$60-70 MM_
3.   **TAO Nightclub**, Las Vegas, NV — _$45-60 MM_

##### 4441 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140, USA

[OPEN IN GOOGLE MAPS](https://maps.google.com/?q=4441%20Collins%20Ave,%20Miami%20Beach,%20FL%2033140,%20USA "OPEN IN GOOGLE MAPS")

[Rating: 4.76 out of 5 based on 17 Reviews](https://www.clubbable.com/Blog/Club-Rating "Club Rating")

LIV opened its door in 2008 for the first time. Miami Marketing Group, being the owner of LIV nightclub, operates it. Grutman owns the LIV hotel and nightclub. He is the CEO and operating partner of the Miami Marketing Group. LIV 4441 Collins Avenue is located in Miami beach; it can be found inside the extraordinary Fontainebleau Hotel in North Miami Beach.

LIV's decor is modern, special and upscale. Please listen to their award-winning Funktion-1 Sound System with deep and powerful bass drop. LED spark lights, neon lights and laser projects from the DJ booth add to the power of this ultra-exclusive nightclub. In order to highlight historic Fontainebleau and contemporary recreation, nightlife in Miami Beach has been redefined. Quintessential nightspot is equipped with MMG nightlife, a super-special lounge application and a high power nightclub fuse. With striking architectural design and formal decorations, LIV sets the stage for the ultimate nightlife experience. In addition to a voyeuristic design throughout the nightclub, you can see a crowd of celebrities, VIPs and Miami's most beautiful crowds.

Music at LIV changes from pop to electronic hip-hop. Dancing is the perfect excuse to dance until Thursday morning and LIV is perfect to take the hottest hip-hop around Sunday. At LIV, expect to be impressed. Their dancers dance over the DJ booths and sometimes on the stilts -by misting the crowd with smoke and water. Confetti joins the excitement from the ceiling, and do not miss the live robot with its cryogenic gun in hand. Special guest and DJ often introduce a groove and dance at the DJ booth with dancers. Club LIV is Open on Wednesday through the nightclubs and Sunday night; as is mostly required in Southern Nightclubs.

LIV has four full-service bars in the club. Two are situated on the main floor, surrounding the VIP sections, and two upstairs servicing the six exclusive skyboxes. All times are stocked thoroughly; South Beach has the offer to serve up the hottest cocktails. Over 18,000 square feet, LIV Miami has a capacity of 1,200 people, which offers views from the main dance floor or from the private six VIP Skybox scenes from upstairs.

The LIV crowd comes from celebrities to local college students so that they can take their night to the next level. If you are nobody, LIV is the place to be in Miami Beach. Justin Bieber, Lil Wayne, Jamie Foxx, Johnny Manziel and Odell Beckham Jr. were just some of the celebrities who partied together at the LIV Miami club. Weezy, Trey Songz, 2 Chainz and Fabolous performed for the crowd that also included Khloe Kardashian, Tristan Thompson, Adrien Brody and Victor Cruz.

LIV is an upscale and trendy dance club so it is the perfect place to show your hottest little black dress. There are no shorts, jewellery or athletic dress for men. The door attendant has the final decision when it comes to entry, so dress to impress. The holiday vibe of Miami Beach is developed on this hot ground, so get wild and hope to see its good looks and luxury. LIV is one of the hottest clubs in Miami, if not the hottest. If you had to choose a club, LIV would have it.

7.title: LIV Nightclub Miami – The Ultimate Nightlife Experience
7.description: LIV Miami: A Glimpse into the Ultimate Nightlife Experience - In the world of nightlife, few places are as iconic as LIV Nightclub in Miami. Located in the ...
7.content:
In the world of nightlife, few places are as iconic as LIV. Located in the heart of Miami Beach, within the historic Fontainebleau Hotel, LIV Nightclub has redefined the nightlife scene, drawing in celebrities, socialites, and party-goers from around the globe. With its opulent design, cutting-edge technology, and an atmosphere that pulses with energy, LIV is more than just a nightclub; it’s an experience.

### LIV Nightclub: A Glimpse into the Ultimate Nightlife Experience

LIV opened its doors in 2008 as part of the grand re-opening of the Fontainebleau Hotel, which underwent a $1 billion renovation. Since then, it has become synonymous with luxury and exclusivity, regularly hosting some of the most high-profile events in the city. Over the years, it has maintained its status as one of the top nightclubs in the world, consistently ranking high on industry lists.

### Design and Atmosphere

From the moment you step inside LIV, you’re immersed in a world of glamour. The club’s design is a modern interpretation of classic elegance, featuring a stunning domed ceiling that stretches over 18,000 square feet. The venue can accommodate up to 1,100 guests, and every inch is thoughtfully designed to enhance the nightlife experience.

The main dance floor is surrounded by VIP tables, allowing guests to enjoy the action up close or from a more private vantage point. The tiered layout ensures that every guest has a view of the DJ booth and the dancers, creating an intimate yet electric atmosphere.

LIV’s lighting system is nothing short of spectacular, with state-of-the-art LED lights that transform the space into a visual wonderland. The sound system is equally impressive, delivering crystal-clear audio that keeps the energy high from dusk till dawn.

### Music and Entertainment

LIV is known for its diverse and dynamic music offerings. The club features a rotating roster of world-renowned DJs, including the likes of Calvin Harris, David Guetta, and Tiësto. Whether it’s EDM, hip-hop, or top 40 hits, the music at LIV is carefully curated to keep the crowd dancing all night long.

In addition to the music, LIV is famous for its extravagant performances. The club frequently hosts live shows by top artists, as well as themed nights and special events that add an extra layer of excitement to the experience. From surprise celebrity appearances to elaborate stage productions, there’s always something unexpected happening at LIV.

![Image 1: View inside LIV Miami nightclub](https://pubcrawlmiami.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/liv-miami-club.jpg)

### The VIP Experience

For those looking to take their night to the next level, LIV offers an unparalleled VIP experience. The club’s VIP tables provide the ultimate in luxury, with personal servers, premium bottle service, and prime views of the dance floor and DJ booth. LIV’s VIP area is where the city’s elite come to see and be seen, making it a must-visit for anyone looking to indulge in Miami’s nightlife at its finest.

### Notable Events and Celebrities

LIV has played host to countless celebrity events over the years, solidifying its reputation as a playground for the rich and famous. From Super Bowl parties to after-parties for major award shows, LIV has seen it all. Celebrities like Kim Kardashian, LeBron James, and Leonardo DiCaprio have all been spotted at LIV, adding to the club’s allure.

One of the most talked-about events in LIV’s history was Lil Wayne’s homecoming party in 2010, following his release from prison. The event drew massive crowds and cemented LIV’s status as the go-to spot for major celebrations.

### Conclusion: LIV Nightclub

LIV Nightclub in Miami is more than just a nightlife destination; it’s a cultural landmark that embodies the essence of Miami’s vibrant, luxurious, and diverse scene. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, a night at LIV is an unforgettable experience that captures the magic of Miami Beach. From its stunning design to its world-class entertainment, LIV continues to set the standard for nightlife, not just in Miami, but around the world. 8.title: Nightlife in America - Krakowboatparty.com
8.description: Nightlife in america is unlike anywhere else in the world. Check out this guide to the best clubs and hotspots for an unforgettable night!
8.content:
The most amazing part about America is that it’s a melting pot. Different cultures and people from around the world reside in the USA, influencing the cities that they live in. Whether it be food, values, or customs, somehow the energy of nightlife stays the same– completely electric!

Major party cities in America are the most visited areas for international tourists. There’s no better way to experience a new culture than to submerge yourself in the party scene. We’ve compiled a list of cities who take pride in their nightlife.

Las Vegas
---------

With the millions of tourists that flock to Las Vegas year round, it’s one of the most visited cities in the entire world. It’s known as Sin City for a multitude of reasons: gambling at casinos where you lose big _or_ win big, drinking before the sun goes down and stopping after it comes back up, clubbing until your shoes or heels have to come off… The debauchery is endless!

If you like to party, beware that the **best nightclubs in Las Vegas** offer a once-in-a-lifetime experience to their guests BUT they can sometimes be expensive and difficult to get into. Securing a spot is only half the battle, the other half is waiting in a very long line to enter! And if you’re pregaming like all the smart people do to reduce the cost of drinks, the buzz is sure to get killed.

The most cost-efficient, and not to mention stress-free, way to get into all the top clubs and bars is by joining a [**Las Vegas club crawl**](http://laepicclubcrawls.com/). Crawl companies like LA Epic Club Crawls hit up some of the best **Las Vegas nightclubs**. Listed below are some of the hottest venues that you need to check out if you’re in Las Vegas.

### Hakkasan Nightclub

![Image 1: Hakkasan Nightclub](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Hakkasan-nightclub-1024x538.jpeg)

_Photo Credit:_[_Hakkasan Nightclub_](https://hakkasannightclub.com/blog/hakkasan-grid-unveiling-edcweek/)

Hakkasan Nightclub has 5 levels to their nightclub, each with their own vibe and music style to accommodate any visitor that may walk through their doors. Their levels are the Hakkasan Restaurant, Private Dining, Club & Lounge, Main Room & Pavilion, and their Mezzanine.

_Located in MGM Grand Hotel & Casino. 3799 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109_

### Omnia Nightclub

![Image 2: Omnia nightclub](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Omnia-nightclub-1024x538.png)

Photo Credit: [Omnia Clubs](https://omniaclubs.com/las-vegas/)

With 3 rooms called the Main, Heart, and Terrace, Omnia is well known for their kinetic chandelier that flows with the vibes in the room. The most electrifying experience is watching that chandelier recoil downwards to the dancefloor while the beat builds up to an insane drop!

_Located in Caesars Palace. 3570 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109_

### Drais Nightclub

![Image 3: Drais nightclub](https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/rFnFFo5yP9CXRT-y7650JD2OnUDMo_8qacQe7SsFBMxgXtQd-ZEKGCkr18UBrOoIejmi3y-pHLaQ2AtPoxTWQZDEqH2u0BNOirhecjOqZ8d9K3JyiU7hfmEpoCqDDvn4_PIDd0Lf=s0)

Photo Credit: [Drai’s Group](https://draisgroup.com/)

Drais satisfies the partygoers that can go all day into the night with a beachclub AND nightclub! Their pool is a multi-level rooftop spot, offering luxury leather seating along with private tables. **Vegas pool parties** are seasonal, so it’s essential that you take the chance when you can! And those who party into the night get to dance under their nightclub’s epic 80-sided LED disco ball.

_Located at The Cromwell Hotel & Casino. 3595 S Las Vegas Blvd, Las Vegas, NV 89109_

### Fremont Street Experience

![Image 4: Freemont street experience](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Fremont-street-experience.jpeg)

Photo Credit: [Vegas Experience | Fremont Street Experience](https://vegasexperience.com/calendar/event/free-concert-chevelle/)

Fremont Street is another notable party scene in Las Vegas. Take a stroll under the LED Viva Vision canopy with 16.4 million brilliant pixels! The **best bars on Fremont Street** are basically right around the corner from each other, making it easy to experience all that **Downtown Las Vegas** has to offer. It’s even easier if you join a guided **Fremont Street bar crawl**!

_Located in Downtown Las Vegas. E Fremont St, Las Vegas, NV 89101_

Miami
-----

Boiled down, party scenes consist of the same elements: partygoers, alcohol, cash, clubs, bars… But there’s something about Miami that has a distinct vibe to it! Maybe it’s the ocean breeze that gives **Miami nightlife** some edge. Who’s to say? Either way, it’s an experience you can’t get anywhere else. Listed below are some of the top clubs.

### LIV Nightclub

![Image 5: LIV nightclub](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/LIV-nightclub-1.png)

_Photo Credit:_[_LIV_](https://www.livnightclub.com/news)

We are no fools– we have to start with the most iconic venue in the entirety of **Miami nightclubs**. LIV Nightclub sets the tone for an epic night: soaring ceilings and electric lighting all encompassed in a dome shape. Paired with multi-level areas, there is so much room to get lit!

_Located in Fontainebleau Hotel. 4441 Collins Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33140_

### Vendôme Nightclub

![Image 6: Vendome nightclub](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/LIV-nightclub.png)

Photo Credit: [Vendôme](https://www.vendome.miami/)

Inspired by Place Vendôme in the heart of Paris, Vendôme Nightclub elicits the same luxury and high-end entertainment to make for a dazzling Miami experience. This club made its debut in only May of 2021. And in this short time period, Vendôme has already earned its title as one of the **best nightclubs in Miami**!

_Located at 743 Washington Ave, Miami Beach, FL 33139_

### Daer Dayclub & Nightclub

![Image 7: Daer dayclub & nightclub](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Vendome-nightclub.png)

Photo Credit: [Hard Rock Nightlife](https://hardrocknightlife.com/south-florida/)

Daer is another venue that offers partygoers the opportunity to get lit all day into the night. Their dayclub offers three pools, luxe seating, private cabanas, and a whopping 40-foot LED screen for DJ performances. **Pool parties in Miami** don’t get better than this! To make matters even more epic, Daer Nightclub won a 2020 Mondo Award in the nightclub category. Its insane and stylish lighting design is equipped with 150 moving lights to shine upon its always-packed dance floor.

_Located at Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino. 1 Lucky St, Hollywood, FL 33314_

Los Angeles
-----------

If you’re trying to party in California, Los Angeles is the place to be! Influencers around the world congregate to this very city, so you know there are many opportunities for juicy content (also known as _remarkable life events_ for the normies). But even with that recommendation, there are so many areas to experience **Los Angeles nightlife**. The most recommended are **Hollywood Boulevard** and **Downtown Los Angeles**. Another plus is that they’re less than an hour’s drive away, so a night could be split into 2 to get more bang for your buck! Here are some venues that know how to party.

### Hollywood: Avalon Nightclub

![Image 8: Avalon nightclub](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Avalon-nightclub.png)

Photo Credit: [Avalon Hollywood](https://avalonhollywood.com/gallery/120118-avalon-amfamfamf-present-destructo-dj-diesel/)

This famous nightclub is known for its deep-rooted history in Los Angeles’ music culture. Avalon has held its title as the **best nightclub in Los Angeles** for years now. When people learn that The Beatles had their first-ever West Coast performance in this very club, their minds are blown away! It’s typical for Avalon to have renowned artists and DJs to walk through these doors. Avalon knows how to party (and after-party, too!).

_Located at 1735 Vine St, Los Angeles, CA 90028._

### Hollywood: Ballet Hollywood

![Image 9: Hollywood: Ballet club](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Hollywood-Ballet-club.png)

Photo Credit: [Ballet Hollywood](https://ballethollywood.com/)

Ballet Hollywood lives up to its name with their decor and architecture. A grandeur chandelier welcomes you into the nightclub, leading you to a grand piano covered in diamonds amidst the dance floor. Don’t let these pristine elements fool you though, it goes down in Ballet Hollywood! The energy here makes it one of the best **Hollywood nightclubs**.

_Located at 6623 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90028_

### Downtown Los Angeles: Exchange LA

![Image 10: Exchange LA](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Exchange-LA.png)

_Photo Credit:_[_YourEDM_](https://www.youredm.com/2016/01/05/exchange-la-got-so-real/)

This newly renovated version of Exchange LA reawakened the nightclub into vibrancy! It doubles an event space for all sorts of shows but most importantly a nightclub venue to serve their patrons daily. If there’s one place you need to visit to experience Los Angeles nightlife, it’s Exchange LA! You’ll get extra points if there’s a huge DJ playing– it can get packed and crazy!!

_Located at 618 S Spring St, Los Angeles, CA 90014_

**Want to party in America?**
-----------------------------

Party scenes can be taunting with the many different venues, dress codes, and price tags. With club crawl companies, experiencing top-tier nightlife in any city is made easy! You get express entry with no cover charges into multiple venues. Some venues offer exclusive drink offers only available to those on the crawl. Party hosts guide you throughout the night to make sure you can drink with no worries!

![Image 11: Want to party in America?](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Want-to-party-in-America.png)

_Photo Credit:_[_LA Epic Club Crawls_](https://laepicclubcrawls.com/)

If you are intrigued by any of the venues listed above and want to visit them in the most cost and energy-efficient way possible, LA Epic Club Crawls is for you! LA Epic Club Crawls is [a premiere nightlife tour company](https://laepicclubcrawls.com/). They operate in major party cities throughout America, like the ones listed above! LA Epic hosts over 650 crawls annually, and over 40,000 guests combined throughout these locations! Don’t be afraid to hit them up for your trip overseas, they’ll make your experience EPIC.

YOU MIGHT ALSO LIKE
-------------------

Are you planning your next vacation and craving a mix of sunshine, sea, and unforgettable nights? If the idea of a boat party excites you, set your sights on Split, Croatia. Known for its ...

[Read more](https://krakowboatparty.com/post/why-split-should-be-your-next-boat-party-stop/)

![Image 13: The Best Hotels In Krakow [Updated 2023 List]](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/themes/krakowboatparty/assets/img/single-post-bg.png)

##### The Best Hotels In Krakow [Updated 2023 List]

Krakow, the former capital of Poland is now the cultural capital of Poland and is one of the many reasons it has become a major tourist destination in Europe. Once the home of Kings, it is now ...

[Read more](https://krakowboatparty.com/post/the-best-hotels-in-krakow/)

![Image 14: The Best Hotels In Krakow [Updated 2023 List]](https://krakowboatparty.com/wp-content/themes/krakowboatparty/assets/img/single-post-bg.png)
